text: For missing file delivery or missing raw rows, check the expected delivery deadline, exact inventory path and access. An absent source input may explain a downstream load failure.
For column or parser errors, compare observed file structure with the approved schema contract before changing a load mapping.
For invalid revenue or numeric values, inspect the value contract and failing samples. Matching column count does not establish valid data types.
For incorrect converted amounts, check effective month of rates and trace the selected reference rate. A successful load can publish stale reference values.
For job or all fact loads failing while source rows exist, inspect processing task errors and runtime dependencies before assuming a missing input.
For inventory job failures, verify the upstream reference dependency and link service health to the affected task. Zero rows alone do not identify an upstream cause.
